stories.story_fr: L'outil en magasin propulsé par l'IA, Mylow, a franchi le cap des 5 millions de questions posées par les associés au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: The AI-powered in-store tool Mylow reached a milestone of 5 million associate questions in Q1 2026.
stories.signal: AI-powered in-store tool Mylow reached 5 million associate questions milestone

stories.story_fr: Lowe's a annoncé un investissement de 250 M$ pour former et développer 250 000 hommes de métier au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: Lowe's announced a $250M investment to train and develop 250,000 tradespeople in Q1 2026.
stories.signal: Announced $250M investment to train develop 250,000 tradespeople

stories.story_fr: Lowe's a investi 8,8 Mds$ pour l'acquisition de Foundation Building Materials (FBM) au T3 2025 afin de renforcer son offre auprès des clients Pro.
stories.story_en: Lowe's invested $8.8 billion for the acquisition of Foundation Building Materials (FBM) in Q3 2025 to enhance its offering to Pro customers.
stories.signal: During the quarter, the company invested $8.8 billion for the acquisition of FBM
